messages.author: 1c00b5de04b9de94
messages.subject: Questions about CFA output
parts:
Hi,

I have a couple of quick questions about the output available from lavaan's CFA function. Is there a way to have lavaan report the inter-factor correlation matrix? How about the average variance extracted (AVE) for each factor?

Thanks!

Sean

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Questions about CFA output
parts:
On 03/10/2013 11:49 PM, Sean Handley wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I have a couple of quick questions about the output available from
> lavaan's CFA function. Is there a way to have lavaan report the
> inter-factor correlation matrix? How about the average variance
> extracted (AVE) for each factor?

I'm not familiar with AVE, but for the inter-factor correlation matrix,
you can use

inspect(fit, "cor.lv")

Yves.

messages.author: d275eff513efeea3
messages.subject: Re: Questions about CFA output
parts:
The AVE can be computed by taking the average of the R-squares within a factor.
To extract the R-squares you can use the inspect function:

inspect(fit, "Rsquare")

Leonard.
